description: This file manages plugin manifest registry, including loading, caching, and deduplication of plugin manifests for the openclaw project.

classes.name: PluginManifestRecord
classes.description: Represents a plugin manifest with all relevant metadata for plugin management.

classes.name: PluginManifestRegistry
classes.description: Contains a list of plugin manifests and diagnostics for the registry.

methods.description: Clears the cached plugin manifest registry.

methods.name: loadPluginManifestRegistry
